items.statement: Both named reduced molecules have traceable S0 and S1 calculations with explicit state validation, atom mapping/alignment, and a stated reorganization-energy/RMSD convention.
items.expected: Per-object optimization/frequency evidence and reproducible mapping/formula documentation are present for p-2BN_reduced and m-2BN_reduced.

items.statement: The submission audits mode/group contributions with identity retained for each reported contribution.
items.expected: Leading displacement contributions are assigned to identifiable backbone or side-group modes for each object, with a stated ranking/selection rule.

items.statement: The computed relaxation is substantially smaller for p-2BN than for m-2BN.
items.expected: p-2BN is reported near 0.19 eV and 0.0671 Å; m-2BN is reported near 0.45 eV and 0.4664 Å, subject to method/convention uncertainty.

items.statement: The leading displacement character differs between the isomers.
items.expected: p-2BN leading λ contributions are mainly pyrazine-backbone vibrations, while m-2BN contributions are principally side-phenyl vibrations.
